exemplars.paper_id: Are We Building on the Rock_ On the Importance of Data Preprocessing for Code Summarization
exemplars.key_insight: 噪声数据广泛存在于31%-66%的样本中,移除噪声后BLEU-4提升21%-27%
exemplars.method_signature: 基于启发式if-else规则的CAT清洗工具,检测并修正/移除12类代码-注释对噪声

exemplars.key_insight: 开发者撰写的摘要包含意图相关参数（如delta值），可补充源代码中缺失的关键断言信息
exemplars.method_signature: 基于CodeT5预训练模型，用特殊token隔离测试前缀、焦点方法和摘要三种输入模态

exemplars.paper_id: Integrating Tree Path in Transformer for Code Representation
exemplars.key_insight: Relative paths reveal token relationships (patterns like for-loops); absolute paths reveal per-token program behavior; both can bias self-attention
exemplars.method_signature: TPTrans: modify Transformer attention with path-encoded relative position representations and layer-normalized GRU encoders

exemplars.paper_id: Backward and Forward Language Modeling for Constrained Sentence Generation
exemplars.key_insight: 从给定词同时向两端生成,无需首词约束即可保证该词出现在任意位置
exemplars.method_signature: 双向/异步B/F RNN语言模型,基于GRU的条件概率乘积分解

exemplars.paper_id: Sequence to Backward and Forward Sequences_ A Content-Introducing∩ü£n Approach to Generative Short-Text Conversation
exemplars.key_insight: 用PMI预测关键词作为生成起点,seq2BF模型从关键词同时向后向前生成,确保关键词出现在任意位置且语义丰富
exemplars.method_signature: seq2BF模型:序列到向后和向前序列

exemplars.paper_id: Backbone Language Modeling for Constrained Natural Language Generation
exemplars.key_insight: 若某词必须出现,以该词为根节点构建贝叶斯网络
exemplars.method_signature: B/F双通道RNN同步或异步从约束词生成前后文
